answer: Welcome to Jayaraj Annapackiam CSI College of Engineering (JACSICE). I am the official campus AI assistant. How may I help you with your academic inquiries today?
Our esteemed institution is the Jayaraj Annapackiam CSI College of Engineering (JACSICE), proudly situated in Nazareth, Tamil Nadu.
JACSICE is strategically located in the serene environment of Nazareth, Thoothukudi district, Tamil Nadu, providing an ideal atmosphere for focused academic pursuits.

JACSICE offers a comprehensive suite of academic programs. Our Undergraduate degrees include B.E. in Computer Science (CSE), Electronics and Communication (ECE), Mechanical Engineering, and B.Tech in Information Technology (IT) and Artificial Intelligence & Data Science (AI&DS). We also offer Postgraduate degrees including M.E. in CSE and a Master of Business Administration (MBA).
Yes, our highly sought-after B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering program is available and currently accommodates an intake of 120 students per academic year.
The Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE) offers a robust program with an annual intake capacity of 60 students.
We proudly offer a B.Tech in Information Technology, designed to equip students with cutting-edge software and networking skills for the modern tech industry.
To meet future industry demands, JACSICE offers a specialized B.Tech degree in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science (AI&DS).
Mechanical Engineering is one of our foundational core departments, focusing on advanced manufacturing, design, and thermal sciences.
Yes, our Department of Management Studies offers a comprehensive Master of Business Administration (MBA) program for aspiring corporate leaders.
The institution is led by our distinguished Principal, Dr. S. Jeyakumar.
You can reach the Principal's office directly via email at principal@jacsicoe.in.

The fee structure varies depending on the specific program and admission quota. We encourage prospective students to contact the administrative office directly for the most accurate and personalized fee details.
JACSICE provides secure, well-maintained hostel facilities for students, offering excellent amenities, hygienic food, and a conducive environment for studying at highly affordable rates.
For the convenience of our day scholars, the college operates a comprehensive fleet of buses covering extensive routes across nearby towns and districts.

Admissions are granted strictly based on academic eligibility and the official state counseling process. Prospective students can apply via the Anna University guidelines or contact our admission cell for management quota details.
During the admission process, candidates must submit their original 10th and 12th-grade mark sheets, official Transfer Certificate (TC), Community Certificate, and valid ID proofs.

Candidates must have successfully completed their Higher Secondary (12th grade) examinations with the minimum required percentage in Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics as mandated by Anna University norms.
For the most detailed and up-to-date information, please visit our official institution website at https://www.jacsicoe.in.

Our central library is a vast repository of knowledge, fully equipped with a massive collection of engineering textbooks, reference materials, international journals, and modern digital e-learning resources.
To support digital learning, the entire JACSICE campus is enabled with high-speed, secure Wi-Fi access for all students and faculty.
The campus houses a highly hygienic and well-maintained cafeteria that provides nutritious and affordable meals and refreshments throughout the day.

JACSICE is committed to accessible education. Various government and institutional scholarships are available to meritorious and economically disadvantaged students based on strict eligibility criteria.
